name: sharekite
description: Publish web pages and files from your agent and share them by link or with the people you name.

interface.longDescription: Sharekite publishes the web pages, reports, and other files that you create in a conversation, and shares them with clients and partners. Each upload becomes a prepared version with a preview link; it goes online only when you ask. You choose who can open the work: anyone with the link, or only the people you name, who receive an email invitation. Later, you can update the same address with a new version and check the status of each invitation. Sharekite hosts static files only: it does not run server code or databases. A conversation can publish a site of up to 100 MiB and 1,000 files, with each file up to 20 MiB.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report and give me a link I can send.
Which of my projects have changes that are not published?
